+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""RoboPaint eai-standard/2.2 episode controller for the Vermeer study.
+
+The helper routines send only vertical-brush poses and keep every painted
+contact as one smooth sweep.  The initial call exercised the same approach
+paths before this record was assembled; the live episode is resumed in place.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+PAPER_Z = 0.0200
+PAINT_Z = 0.0175
+PALETTE_Z = 0.0240
+DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=float)
+
+
+def spaced(a, b, step=0.008):
+    a, b = np.asarray(a, float), np.asarray(b, float)
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b - a) / step)))
+    return [a + (b - a) * i / n for i in range(1, n + 1)]
+
+
+def pack_path(path_xyz, quat=DOWN):
+    return np.asarray([np.r_[xyz, quat] for xyz in path_xyz], dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def current_pose(r):
+    return np.asarray(r.get_obs().meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14], float)
+
+
+def go_path(r, xyz_path, cameras=None, video="none", note=""):
+    p = current_pose(r)
+    q = p[3:]
+    full = []
+    for xyz in xyz_path:
+        full.extend(spaced(p[:3] if not full else full[-1], xyz))
+    if not full:
+        return None
+    return r.submit("ee_pose", pack_path(full, q), dt=0.05,
+                    cameras=cameras, video=video, note=note)
+
+
+def contact_sweep(r, xy_points, z=PAINT_Z, cameras=None, note=""):
+    """Execute one no-lift contact sweep at the requested sheet coordinates."""
+    xyz = [[float(x), float(y), float(z)] for x, y in xy_points]
+    return go_path(r, xyz, cameras=cameras, note=note)
+
+
+def calibrate():
+    r = Robot()
+    p = current_pose(r)
+    # The darkest well is the third position in the fifth palette row.
+    # The palette was localized from scene_cam and its depth map.
+    well = np.array([-0.0585, 0.1830, PALETTE_Z])
+    practice_start = np.array([-0.155, -0.215, 0.13])
+    path = []
+    high = max(0.24, float(p[2]))
+    path += spaced(p[:3], [p[0], p[1], high])
+    path += spaced(path[-1], [-0.0585, 0.1830, 0.24])
+    path += spaced(path[-1], well)
+    path += [well.copy(), well.copy()]
+    path += spaced(path[-1], [-0.0585, 0.1830, 0.13])
+    path += spaced(path[-1], practice_start)
+    path += spaced(path[-1], [-0.155, -0.215, PAINT_Z])
+    path += spaced(path[-1], [-0.080, -0.165, PAINT_Z])
+    path += spaced(path[-1], [-0.080, -0.165, 0.13])
+    result = r.submit("ee_pose", pack_path(path, p[3:]), dt=0.05,
+                      cameras=["practice_cam", "side_cam"], video="none",
+                      note="dark-paint practice sweep and contact calibration")
+    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=["practice_cam", "scene_cam", "side_cam"])
+    for cam, frame in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f"calibrated_{cam}.png")
+    print("calibration", result.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"),
+          result.meta.get("plan"), "pose", result.meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14])

+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":

+    else:
